newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends firm as cash pulls futures higher.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends firm as cash pulls futures higher.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed firm as the premium U.S. cash markets hold to futures again served as a bullish magnet, traders said.
Support also came from relatively light producer selling and signals for a steady export sales pace of U.S. rice, they said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 350 contracts, below the 627 traded Thursday, according to the CBOT.
Rice futures closed unchanged to two cents per cwt higher, with January up two at $10.74 per cwt.
